title: تفويض الوكلاء بحدود
rule:
Applies when: When delegating or parallelizing.
Give workers no broader grants than the parent and prevent conflicting writers; qualify delegated tool boundaries and cancellation.
rationale: تفويض عامل بصلاحيات أوسع قد يفتح مسار تجاوز مستقل. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
